verdict.rationale: Pinecone's docs say you can create backups of serverless indexes through the SDK, API, or console, which covers the backup half of the story. Restoring is only implied by the phrase "copy indexes"; no restore workflow is documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of restoring an index from a backup, coverage beyond serverless indexes (pod-based indexes or collections), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can back up collections with snapshots and restore them

citations.quote: Create backups of serverless indexes to protect data, copy indexes, or experiment with configurations using the Pinecone SDK, API, or console.
Overview of Pinecone security features for production: API keys, SSO, service accounts, audit logs, CMEK encryption, backups, and Private Endpoints.
